text:
alex.support: FYI customer acme-prod (org 4321) reporting hourly metrics missing/delayed ~6h starting around 03:00 UTC. Console shows empty windows 03:00-09:00. They just called, escalation requested.
jess-cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) send events to /v1/ingest 2) wait for hourly rollup (should appear within 15m) 3) nothing for hours. Tenant id: 4321. Attached screenshot of blank sparkline.
ingest-bot: [ingest-monitor] consumer-group=ingest-workers, partition=12, lag=230230, last_commit=2026-03-16T02:45:12Z. Recent error count spike: ETLConsumer.RetryLimitReached x12.
maria-ops: I checked S3 manifests: last manifest for prefix tenants/4321/hourly at 02:58:43 had an incomplete multipart commit, S3 returned 500 for 10s then retried. Looks like a short window where manifests weren't visible to downstream. No obvious permission/auth failures.
sam-eng: Seeing worker flapping on autoscaler around 02:57-03:05. Logs show OOM and then `ETLConsumer: Retry limit reached` for several messages. Suspect rehydration queue stalled and backpressure cascaded to the hourly producer. Propose: 1) scale ingest-workers to 6, 2) run targeted backfill for tenant 4321 between 03:00-09:00 with dedupe, 3) monitor alerts. Commands:
```
kubectl scale deployment ingest-workers --replicas=6 -n prod-ingest
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group ingest-workers --describe
python tools/backfill.py --tenant 4321 --start 2026-03-16T03:00Z --end 2026-03-16T09:00Z --dry-run
```
lee-sre: Before doing backfill, confirm idempotency keys and avoid double-counting. Query I ran:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id = 4321 AND hour >= '2026-03-16' AND hour < '2026-03-17';
```
Result: 0 rows for the affected hours.
alex.support: Thanks. Customer asks about billing — will these late rows retroactively affect billing? We need to tell them yes/no depending on dedupe logic.
sam-eng: Backfill will use dedupe keys (event_id + hour). So counts should not double-charge. We'll also run a dry-run first which looked clean (no conflicting primary keys). Starting scale now and then run live backfill.
ingest-bot: Action: scaled ingest-workers -> 6 replicas. Consumer lag decreased: 230230 -> 80012 in ~4m.
maria-ops: Dry-run backfill returned jobs to create=6, estimated duration ~45m if parallelized. No duplicate-key errors in dry-run.
jess-cs: Notified customer: "We are running a targeted replay for your tenant, expect metrics to start populating within ~1h, will update as we progress." They acknowledged and will hold off external changes. :thumbsup:
sam-eng: Launching live backfill now. Command:
```
python tools/backfill.py --tenant 4321 --start 2026-03-16T03:00Z --end 2026-03-16T09:00Z --dedupe --submit
# output: jobs_created=6, job_group=bf-20260316-4321
```
ingest-bot: Backfill accepted job_group=bf-20260316-4321, progress=2/6 completed, workers processing partitions 10-12.
lee-sre: Silencing hourly-rollup-lag alert for tenant 4321 during backfill window to avoid alert noise. Monitoring retention dashboards and write-through latency.
alex.support: Update: customer reports hours starting to reappear at 04:20 UTC, still catching up to 09:00. I'll keep this thread open until fully caught up and we verify no billing anomalies. Thanks all :heart:
